blocks.text: All whistleblower reports received through the Ethics Hotline are logged by the Compliance officer, who must acknowledge receipt to the reporter within 2 business days.
If the report implicates a VP or above (senior leadership), it is routed directly to the Audit Committee and bypasses the normal Compliance investigation track.
For all other reports, Compliance and Legal investigate in parallel. Legal reviews for attorney-client privilege considerations; Compliance interviews witnesses and collects evidence.

If the investigation finds substantiated violations, HR and Legal jointly determine the appropriate remediation. All investigation findings, regardless of outcome, are reported to the Audit Committee.
